name: puakma-react
description: React + esbuild front end for a Puakma Tornado app; the build writes bundle.js into the app clone's RESOURCE folder.

puakma.//: The Puakma app this repo deploys to. Set both once (and rename this package), then `npm run deploy` (locally and in CI) does the rest.
puakma.// app: group/name of the app you created by importing puakma/puakma-react-<version>.pmx in webdesign. Never an app id: ids change.
